participant_id.Description: Participant label as used in the source files and the paper (S4, S5, S6)

age.Description: Age in years. Not released per participant; source silent for S4-S6. Cohort (Stolk et al. 2019, Methods 'Participants'): 11 implanted participants aged 14-45 years (9 analysed behaviourally, 7 with sensorimotor coverage).

sex.Description: Sex. Not released per participant; source silent for S4-S6. Cohort (Stolk et al. 2019, Methods 'Participants'): 7 of 11 participants male.

handedness.Description: Handedness. Not reported in the paper (Stolk et al. 2019) or the OSF record z4hfm.

source_label.Description: Participant label in the paper (S1-S7 notation of Stolk et al. 2019) and the OSF file names

pathology.Description: Clinical indication for the subdural implantation: localisation of the seizure onset zone for subsequent surgical resection (Stolk et al. 2019, Methods 'Participants')

implant_type.Description: Implant type: subdural grid and strip electrode arrays (Ad-Tech, Racine, USA; 10 mm inter-electrode spacing, 2.3 mm exposed diameter), placed at the University Medical Center Utrecht (Stolk et al. 2019, Methods)

implanted_hemisphere.Description: Hemisphere covered by the electrode arrays, derived from this release: sign of x of every electrode in *_electrodes.tsv (source FieldTrip elec.chanpos) and the hemisphere suffix of the authors' AAL atlas labels (all electrodes *_R for S4, all *_L for S5 and S6). Cohort (paper): 8 of 11 left, 3 right.

n_electrodes.Description: Number of electrodes (= ECoG channels) in the released data of this participant (*_electrodes.tsv rows, *_ieeg.json ECOGChannelCount). Cohort (paper): 81.3 +/- 11.2 electrodes (mean +/- SEM) over the 11 participants.

paper_neural_analysis.Description: Role of the participant in the paper's neural analyses (Stolk et al. 2019, Results: 'This analysis yielded ... peak activity electrodes for participants S1 - S5 ... Due to limited sensorimotor coverage, the number of electrodes could not be narrowed down for participant S6, and the four stimulation-positive electrodes in this participant were used for the analysis of temporal dynamics only.')

Levels.temporal_dynamics_only: limited sensorimotor coverage; the four stimulation-positive electrodes used for the temporal-dynamics analysis only (participant S6)
